create.name: Zen Fields
create.bio:
Zen Fields is a Soto Zen sangha in central Iowa, run as a non-profit and centred on the college town of Ames, where it sits in the Quaker Friends Meeting House on South Maple Avenue. Its teachers also travel to Pure Land of Iowa, a shared Buddhist practice space in Clive, so that students in both places can sit and meet a teacher close to home.

Two married priests lead it, both recognised by the Soto school as international Zen teachers. Daishin Eric McCabe studied ecology and world religions at Bucknell, apprenticed for fifteen years with Patricia Dai-En Bennage Roshi, trained in Japanese monasteries and with Thich Nhat Hanh in France, and is currently acting head priest at the Zen centre in Omaha, Nebraska. Jisho Sara Siebert came to Zen through her work against violence towards women and girls and trained with Gengo Akiba Roshi.

The weekly rhythm includes early online zazen three mornings a week, Monday sitting with shared reading, a Thursday guided meditation circle and a family programme mixing meditation, song and art. Half-day sits, an intro course and a December Rohatsu sesshin fill out the year, and Daishin's dharma talks and short teachings on shikantaza reach a wide audience on YouTube.

courses.title: Rohatsu Sesshin
courses.description: A weekend sesshin marking the Buddha's awakening, held at a retreat centre in Newton, Iowa, from Friday evening to Sunday lunchtime, with periods of sitting and walking meditation. Register through the site's events form.

courses.title: Private Classes with Daishin McCabe
courses.description: One-to-one sessions tailored to the student, covering meditation or yoga instruction, spiritual counselling or Japanese calligraphy; Daishin can travel to teach at home.

courses.title: Join Zen Fields as a Member
courses.description: A yearly offering that keeps the sangha's retreats low-cost; members can take part in the annual board meeting, receive event news and join the members' discussion forum.

free_resources.title: Instructions for Zen Meditation
free_resources.description: Video instruction in seated Zen meditation from the sangha's teacher, with follow-on micro-meditation pages.

free_resources.title: Zen Fields YouTube Talks
free_resources.description: A selection of Daishin McCabe's short dharma talks and guided practices, on topics such as the trikaya, mindful breathing, the precepts and dropping the sense of a separate doer.
